Name: Forge - Craft Your Own Equipment
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
This mod adds a new forge building with 3 crafting stations that you can buy from Robin.

It also has seasonal sprites and a custom skin.

The stations are forge, anvil and table.

You can click on the stations to open crafting menus with new categories.

More crafting recipes will be unlocked as each skill level is increased.
